question: Can any state of experience be entirely free from auspicious and inauspicious results?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious experiences arise together
No situation lacks such experiential duality
Experience remains mixed in ordinary conditions
inference: Everywhere experience includes both auspicious and inauspicious elements.
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious experiences must be undergone, and nowhere is one ever devoid of them.
